title: Change request against tailored.json
description: out/<run-slug>/edits/NNN.json. Produced by the AI from a checkpoint-2 reply, a free-text instruction ('drop Mindgeek'), or a critic suggestion the user accepted. Applied deterministically, in order, by `cvt apply-edits`, which re-runs check-tailored and refuses the whole batch on any violation.

raw_text.description: User words verbatim (or critic issue text).

op.description: approve_all: mark every pending item approved (target_id ''). approve: one item. reject: remove a proposed/rewritten item and restore its original profile text if one exists, else drop. replace_text: new text for a bullet/summary/headline (source_refs required). drop: remove item (recorded in omitted). restore: bring back an omitted profile item by profile ID. move_before: reorder target before value (an ID). set_field: see field. add_skill/remove_skill: target_id = skills group t-skl-N, value = skill name. set_priority: value '1'..'5'.

target_id.description: Tailored ID (t-...), profile ID for restore, or '' for approve_all/set_field on run options.

value.description: New text/value as a string ('true'/'false' for booleans). '' when not applicable.

items.description: Extra target IDs when one op applies to several items (e.g. drop several bullets); [] otherwise.
